headline: Cyient Limited dissolves Infotech HAL Limited, its joint venture company
sum: Cyient Limited announced the dissolution of Infotech HAL Limited, a joint venture entity, via stock exchange disclosure on 21 August 2026.
implication: JV dissolution triggers mandatory corporate restructuring compliance under Companies Act 2013 (winding-up provisions) and requires stock exchange notification of material corporate events; relevant for tracking portfolio company exits and consolidation in tech M&A practice.
detail: Cyient Limited, listed on NSE, formally notified the stock exchange of the dissolution of Infotech HAL Limited, its joint venture company. The disclosure was filed as a general update under listing regulations. No consideration amount, effective date of dissolution, or wound-up partner details were disclosed in the exchange filing. The event signals a strategic consolidation or restructuring of Cyient's joint venture portfolio.
